classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Find, analyze, and rank representative sequences for NAD(P)HX repair proteins carrying ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase (GO:0097056) and NADPHX epimerase (GO:0097057) activities using local VPA tools
assumptions: GO:0097056 (NAD(P)H-hydrate ADP-dehydratase activity) and GO:0097057 (NADPHX epimerase activity) are the correct GO molecular function terms for the two enzymatic activities of NAD(P)HX repair proteins

Restricting to SwissProt-reviewed entries (reviewed=true) provides the highest-quality manually annotated sequences; exclude_iea=true removes electronically inferred annotations to increase reliability
Up to 30 reviewed sequences per GO term balances phylogenetic coverage with ESM3 compute budget; NAD(P)HX repair is broadly conserved so diversity is expected across kingdoms
ESM3 embedding track outputs serve as sequence-space diversity proxies for representativeness ranking, supplementing classical sequence-analysis metrics
rank_designs aggregates composition, charge, motif, and ESM3 embedding metrics to produce a top-10 representative candidate list spanning both enzymatic activities
Literature evidence from two focused queries contextualizes sequence diversity, known catalytic residues, and phylogenetic spread but is not passed as a scoring input to rank_designs
go_sequences outputs both fasta_path (for sequence_analysis) and sequences list (for ESM3 foreach fan-out); item.sequence is the single-letter sequence string for each record

success_criteria.top_k_ranked_candidates: Top 10 representative NAD(P)HX repair protein sequences ranked by biochemical diversity and ESM3 embedding coverage drawn from both dehydratase and epimerase GO-annotated sets
success_criteria.sequence_analysis_reports: Per-residue biochemical annotations, motif/region profiles, and compositional statistics for both GO:0097056 and GO:0097057 sequence sets
success_criteria.esm3_embeddings: Sequence and embedding tracks for each candidate enabling downstream clustering and diversity assessment
success_criteria.literature_summary: Key publications on NAD(P)HX repair enzyme mechanism, phylogenetics, and functional annotation from two complementary queries

inputs.query: NAD(P)HX repair dehydratase epimerase ADP-dependent metabolite enzyme
NADPHX epimerase dehydratase phylogenetics conservation catalytic mechanism function
